note: This market's affiliate booking destinations, keyed by the policy package's identity_key. A row binds one approved program deep link to one property and records the official URL it was mapped against; the build refuses a row whose provider is not enrolled, whose host is not allowlisted, or whose property has since changed its official URL. Every row names the human who approved it. No row here creates a booking link on its own: the booking CTA is a separate founder/design decision.
